primary.label: author lemma environment with its own label lemma-families-specialization-fppf-descent (no canonical tag in the snapshot tag list); statement at source lines 1021-1030

proof_spans.label: the author's own proof environment immediately following the lemma: Deduce the forward direction from functoriality of the relative cycle property, and for the converse test the specialization condition against a valuation ring and compare the coefficients of the desired identity after pulling back to each member of the family over the closed point, where the first pullback commutes with the specialization map by the flat-pullback compatibility lemma, the second is the assumed relative cycle property of the pulled back families, and the family of closed-fibre pullback maps is jointly injective because the morphisms are jointly surjective and flat (source lines 1032-1058)
